---
title: "Swisstopo"
description: "STAC discovery, elevation point clouds and orthophotos."
---

<div class="toolbox-kind">Index</div>

- [geo.admin STAC](../recipes/geoadmin-stac.qmd): discover first, download second.
- [swissSURFACE3D](../recipes/swisssurface3d.qmd): point-cloud discovery, official DSM alternative and R/`lidR` or PDAL raster pipelines.
- [SWISSIMAGE](../recipes/swissimage.qmd): verified resolution selection, download, mosaic and optional crop.

Both acquisition recipes use stable collection IDs and retain the selected item dates and asset metadata.
